resources.string: Tap the centre of the book to open the menu.
Drag the page to the left to keep reading.
Drag the page to the right to turn back.
Tap the outer left edge to turn back.
Tap the outer right edge for the next page.
Tap the ribbon at the top of the page to add or remove a bookmark. Open Bookmarks in the reading menu to return to a saved place.
In FB2 and EPUB books, tap an illustration to open it. Pinch or double-tap to zoom, then drag to see the details. Hold an illustration on the page for a quick preview.
Hold a cover and drag it onto the centre of another. Wait for the hint, release and name your stack. Tap a stack to open it; hold and release without dragging to open its menu.
Tap the magnifying glass or pull down at the top of the shelf. Search by title, author or series — books inside stacks are included.
On the shelf: closer or farther
Pinch to see more books; spread two fingers to bring covers closer. The shelf has three zoom levels. Return here any time through Reading guide in the book menu or shelf settings.
Spread two fingers on the page to enlarge the text; pinch to make it smaller. The size changes when you lift your fingers. Your reading place and preferred size are saved.
Pinch a PDF page to open it in a larger view. Pinch to zoom and drag to move around. Double-tap to fit the whole page or enlarge it again. Close the view or press Back to return to the same page.
